newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Turkish opposition leader assaulted in Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Turkish opposition leader assaulted in Hungary.

text.p: Turkish opposition leader Mesut Yilmaz was attacked in the lobby of a Budapest hotel on Sunday evening, police said.
Yilmaz, head of the Motherland Party, was drinking coffee when three men approached him and one punched him in the face, giving him a bloody nose.
Yilmaz checked out of the hotel and could not be reached for comment. Hotel officials said the Turkish embassy in Budapest had asked them not to divulge details.
Yilmaz was quoted by Turkey's semi-official Anatolian news agency as saying his assailant fled after the attack.
"I was having coffee in the hotel lobby when someone I don't know came up and punched me," Yilmaz told Anatolian. "I don't know if he was a Turk or not."
The agency quoted a businessman accompanying Yilmaz as saying the attack was related to Yilmaz's role in exposing a security scandal that has rocked Turkey.
